summary: AI-linked stocks dragged the tape lower on Thursday, with chipmakers leading the slide after a revenue setback at OpenAI rattled the AI trade. Oil moved the other way, rising on Middle East and hurricane supply worries.
market_note: Index futures slipped late: S and P futures down about 0.4 percent, Nasdaq futures down about 1.3 percent.

items.why: Down with the AI-trade selloff. Market headlines say Nasdaq fell about 1 percent as AI stocks stumbled after an OpenAI revenue setback.
Hit by the same AI-trade pullback that sank chip and tech names. Headlines describe AI-related stocks struggling as investors question the rally.
Crude rose on Middle East and hurricane supply worries, per today's market headlines, even as the broader tape sold off.
Slid alongside other large tech names in the AI-trade selloff. Headlines cite falling technology stocks and a widening gap between AI names and the rest.
